posts.summary_en: Official 9/23 patch notes: main-stage difficulty relief for 169-1..328-30 and boss balance changes for 169-1..248-30 (Cool Mint, Biker Gang Biker, Biker Gang Truck, Coward, Whipped Cream Cone Eagle, Contaminated Stump Spirit, Redberry Assassin, Choco Cream Wolf Hammer Princess); the Dimensional Rift opens for players who finished the main stages; Continuum Cog pet boosts boss damage in the Rift; new Skill Ready stat; gear presets usable with oven gear. Numbers for the relief are not given. Images/GIFs not read.
mechanics: Main stage 169-1~328-30 difficulty eased; 169-1~248-30 some bosses rebalanced: 쿨링민트맛 쿠키 / 폭주단 바이커 / 폭주단 트럭 / 비겁한 쿠키 / 생크림콘 독수리 / 오염된 그루터기 정령 / 레드베리 암살자 / 초코크림늑대 망치공주. No numbers published.

Skill Ready (스킬준비): % cut to the time until the first skill only; computed on the Skill-Haste-shortened cycle. Already-instant cookies show 100% (감초, 석류, 마카롱, 치즈케이크, 정글전사, 이름 모를 케이크 들개, 탐험가, 브라이트시커, 피노누아, 실론나이트). +25%: 독버섯, 코코아, 양파, 피겨여왕. +50%: 오븐방랑자, 크림소다, 이온, 오렌지, 락스타, 딸기쇼트케이크.
Gear presets can now be switched even with oven gear equipped; oven auto-open substat picks raised to 5.

New pet 색동주머니: lift resistance + max HP to allies. New cookies 바리공주 (TSSR fire charge; grants DMG reduction and lift/push immunity to itself and charge allies) and 감감술래 놀이 달토끼 (SSR grass tank; lowers enemy ATK and crit rate).
rift: 차원의 이면 is seasonal per update; requires the last main stage cleared.
Own growth stat 차원의 힘 levels raise stats; normal-monster phase is skipped, so you fight the next level's boss immediately.
Clears give a season-only profile frame; 차원의 조각 fragments buy the exclusive pet and rewards in its shop.
무한바퀴 (SSR pet, Rift shop only): raises allies' boss damage in the Rift.
disagreements: Commenter 쿠쿠루핑퐁 objects to more difficulty relief ('what about people who climbed the hard way'); 월린 says the Rift replaces adding more stages.

quotes.kr: 메인 스테이지 169-1~328-30 구간 난이도 완화
quotes.en: Main stage 169-1 to 328-30 difficulty eased.

쿠키키키's compiled guide (sources: DC and 서신우): presets for lift bosses (Hammer/Cool Mint), Coward, <=3 bosses, >3 bosses, Stump, Redberry Assassin, auto-hunt, and Bari decks at 35% and 55%, plus per-boss movement tips. teams.why: ATK order 우유-시커-바리-체콜-피겨 for Pomegranate/Macaron targeting.

builds.thresholds: ATK rank 1 after pet, perk and captain ATK are counted (not the displayed ATK)

mechanics: At a 35% cut for Coward, reaching 55% and clearing within 20 tries beats infinite retries at 35%.
Preset names can serve as a memo (e.g. '1망쿨 2비 3인이하 4다인5그루').
stage_types: Hammer: go right; keep Scorpion on the left and the rest on the right so Scorpion isn't hit; retry.
Coward: ~8 Scorpion stacks before the fear; after fear check ~15 stacks else retry; stay still while scattered, then re-engage dodging its skill.
Cool Mint: spin the cookies at the start so they bunch, rather than the far-left corner.
Truck: dodge left once, down once, then auto (hugging the left corner dodges automatically).
Stump: small step left then right to engage; add Licorice if needed.
Redberry Assassin: go bottom-left, don't auto yet; move slowly toward the assassins when the rear ones attack.
Bikers: nudge so all three go one way; going into the centre scatters them and wastes time.
Projectile bosses (식쿠, 독수리): map objects block one projectile.
Survival: if cookies die at the start, step left and wait for Herb's cooldown.

쿠키키키's gear guide. Stage: without oven options, aim for accuracy and focus ~900-1,000 each, then pick the highest-power gear; crit rate over crit damage (enemies have no crit resistance); crit resistance is low value, take DMG reduction. Skill Haste need not be chased for stages. Arena and conquest layouts are given for contrast.

builds.gear: 명중 and 집중 first, then highest-power pieces; 치확 > 치피; 피감 over 치저
builds.why: Enemy monsters have no crit resistance; crit res is inefficient in stages.

builds.gear: top-left 스증/치확·치피; bottom-left 피감/치저; top-right 스가/스증; bottom-right 스가/치피·피감; 스가 x6 required; 1 line of 명중 if needed; no 집중
A: 스증 + 치확/치피; B: 스가 + 스증; C: 피감 + other; D: 스가 + 피감; no 명중/집중

mechanics: Gear substats appear in fixed positions per slot letter (author reply).
disagreements: Conquest: 레벅 argues move speed on bottom-right beats DMG reduction since everyone dies ~17 s; 밀키유입뉴비 says top players use 피감+체력 / 피감+스가 to survive the 17 s slam.

quotes.kr: 스테이지에서는 우선 명중과 집중을 900~1,000 정도 확보하는 것이 중요하며, 해당 수치를 충분히 확보했다면 스킬 가속보다는 전투력이 높은 장비를 우선적으로 사용하셔도 괜찮습니다.
quotes.en: In stages, first secure ~900-1,000 accuracy and focus; once you have that, prefer higher-power gear over Skill Haste.
